label: Row
purpose: A single row — meaning depends on which section it's in: a comparison-table feature row, or a results-section stat row
_notes:
One block type shared by 2 different real components — only use the fields for the section this block is actually in: (1) In comparison-table: 'benefit' (the feature being compared, inline_richtext, no

tags) plus 'us'/'others'/'others_2'/'others_3' checkboxes (does our product have it vs. up to 3 competitor columns). (2) In results: 'percentage' (a stat number), 'row_heading', and 'row_text' (richtext, MUST be wrapped in

tags).
